title: Transformer-based MRI model predicts early recurrence of HBV-related HCC after ablation
summary: A retrospective study of 166 patients with hepatitis B-associated HCC treated with microwave ablation at two hospitals (116 training patients from the first, 50 external validation patients from the second) used a transformer-based deep learning network to fuse multi-sequence MRI and predict recurrence within 1 year. A nomogram combining the deep learning radiomics score, AST and portal hypertension outperformed the clinical and MRI-only models, with AUCs of 0.868 in training and 0.842 in external validation. The external cohort is small.
